hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote using a custom curve invariant, deposits input tokens into the corresponding Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the other vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all pool accounting, allowing LPs to earn both swap fees and lending yield simultaneously.
